items.title: 〈台股風向球〉國安基金進場對決外資提款 拚年線上築出大盤底部
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: National Security Fund Enters to Counter Foreign Capital Withdrawals, Aiming to Build Bottom Above the Year Line
paras: 台股上周五經歷史上最黑暗的黑色星期五，造成周跌點多達5510點，跌幅達12%，並跌破40000點整數大關，隨著美股費半指數上周五反彈、台積電ADR也止跌彈升6%，市場期待台股出現低檔支撐，本周將看到國安基金上膛對決外資重手出場以及融資減肥的壓力，法人認為較好情形是在年線之上築出大盤底部。
上周外資在台股集中市場賣超多達5244億元，同時，外資期貨淨空單達99930口，加上新台幣匯率一度貶破33元重要大關，尚未看到外資停下從台股重手提款的訊號。

而外資一周來主要賣超張數前10大標的多為ETF，依序為主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)、元大台灣50(0050-TW)、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)、主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)、主動群益科技創新(00992A-TW)、力積電(6770-TW)、台積電(2330-TW)、主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)和中信台日韓PCB(009828-TW)。
以金額來看，則是台積電一周來遭外資提款1819億元最多，其次為聯發科(2454-TW)近700億元，元大台灣50達340億元，日月光投控(3711-TW)277億元，欣興(3037-TW)167億元，南亞(1303-TW)逾150億元，台達電(2308-TW)也有140億元。
台股交易員提醒，內資方面同樣有壓，儘管投信撐盤，但面對中實戶主力和散戶尚有5341億元的融資餘額，仍不得不提防反彈有壓、下跌又造成融資斷頭。
不過，台股交易員認為，投資人若無急迫性變現壓力，倒無需過度看壞後市，國安基金已宣布周一進場，此為台股史上第10次護盤，而據統計，過去9次國安基金護盤有8次均為正報酬。
永豐投顧則指出，台股近期重跌，然融資減肥有限，但此次下跌主因美國民主黨大勝後對AI發展路徑投下變數，不能與過去高槓桿操作失誤等量齊觀，目前市場對AI產業前景急劇反轉有極度恐慌，事態未明，先觀望等待。
永豐投顧認為，先等待融資籌碼變化，若出現大幅減少，行情才能反轉，本周指數區間看38000點至40000點。
至於AI科技革命，長線目標不變，是短線投資會受到本益比的衝擊。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced its darkest Black Friday last Friday, dropping 5,510 points—a 12% decline—and falling below the 40,000-point round number. With the US Nasdaq index rebounding and TSMC ADRs snapping a loss to rise 6%, the market is looking for low‑level support. This week will see the National Security Fund loading up to confront heavy foreign outflows and the pressure of margin‑call reductions, and institutions believe the best case is a market bottom forming above the yearly moving average.

Last week foreign investors sold a net NT$5.244 billion in Taiwan's main board, while their net short futures position reached 99,930 contracts. The New Taiwan dollar also briefly slipped past the NT$33 per US$ mark, and there is still no sign that foreign investors are pausing their large‑scale withdrawals from Taiwanese equities.

The top ten securities that foreign investors sold the most over the week were mainly ETFs, in order: Active CTBC Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), Active Uni‑Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW), Active Uni‑Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW), KGI Taiwan Select High‑Yield (00919‑TW), Active KGI Tech Innovation (00992A‑TW), Powerchip (6770‑TW), TSMC (2330‑TW), Active Cathay Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) and CTBC Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW).

By dollar amount, TSMC saw the largest foreign outflow last week at NT$181.9 billion, followed by MediaTek (2454‑TW) with nearly NT$70 billion, Yuanta Taiwan 50 at NT$34 billion, ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) at NT$27.7 billion, Unimicron (3037‑TW) at NT$16.7 billion, Nan Ya (1303‑TW) over NT$15 billion, and Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) with NT$14 billion.

Taiwan stock traders warn that domestic investors also face pressure. Although mutual funds are providing support, there remains NT$534.1 billion of margin debt from institutional and retail investors, meaning a rebound could be constrained and a further drop might trigger margin calls.

Nevertheless, traders say that if investors are not forced to liquidate urgently, there is no need to be overly pessimistic. The National Security Fund announced it would enter the market on Monday, marking the 10th historic market‑support intervention, and statistics show that eight of the previous nine interventions yielded positive returns.

Yong‑Feng Investment Advisory notes that the recent sharp decline was not driven by margin‑call reductions, but mainly by uncertainty after the U.S. Democratic landslide, which introduced new variables to AI development pathways. This differs from past mistakes tied to high‑leverage trading, and the market is currently panicking over a sudden reversal in AI industry prospects, leaving the situation unclear and prompting a wait‑and‑see stance.
Yong‑Feng expects the market to first watch margin‑position changes; a significant reduction could allow a reversal. This week they forecast the index to trade between 38,000 and 40,000 points.
Regarding the AI technology revolution, the long‑term target remains unchanged, but short‑term investments will be affected by price‑to‑earnings ratios.

items.title: 美國擬將伊朗海上封鎖擴大至陸上！成立「鐵門特遣隊」鎖定武器運輸與非法收入
items.title_en: US Plans to Expand Iran Maritime Blockade onto Land, Forming “Task Force Iron Gate” to Target Weapons Shipments and Illicit Revenue
paras: 在對伊朗實施長達數月的海上封鎖後，美軍正籌組一支特遣隊，以加強華府限制伊朗透過陸地邊境及裏海運送先進武器系統與其他受制裁物資的行動。
根據《路透》報導，美軍中央司令部尚未發布的聲明指出，這項成立工作小組的消息預計於周六（7日）稍晚正式公布。
這支特遣隊將命名為「鐵門特遣隊」（Task Force Iron Gate），總部設於佛羅里達州坦帕市，並將與美國其他政府部門協調合作。除了武器運輸外，特遣隊也將把軍民兩用物資及非法收入來源列為關注重點。
美國中央司令部司令庫柏（Brad Cooper）海軍上將在聲明中表示：「強化中央司令部與美國政府跨部門合作夥伴的協作，將進一步限制伊朗資助恐怖主義、重建武器工廠及補充軍事力量的能力。」
美國中央司令部估計，海上封鎖已阻止伊朗出口價值超過250億美元的原油。
paras_en: After months of a maritime blockade against Iran, the U.S. military is assembling a task force to strengthen Washington’s effort to curb Iran’s transport of advanced weapons systems and other sanctioned goods via land borders and the Caspian Sea.
According to Reuters, a statement yet to be released by U.S. Central Command says the news of forming the working group is expected to be announced later on Saturday the 7th.

The task force will be called “Task Force Iron Gate,” will be headquartered in Tampa, Florida, and will coordinate with other U.S. government agencies. In addition to weapons shipments, the unit will focus on dual‑use items and sources of illicit revenue.

U.S. Central Command commander Admiral Brad Cooper said in the statement, “Strengthening collaboration between Central Command and cross‑agency partners in the U.S. government will further limit Iran’s ability to fund terrorism, rebuild weapons factories, and replenish its military forces.”
Central Command estimates that the maritime blockade has already stopped Iran from exporting more than $25 billion worth of crude oil.

items.title: 應輝達要求研擬生產3D DRAM？台積電最新回應！
items.title_en: TSMC Responds to Nvidia's Request to Explore 3D DRAM Production
paras: 市場傳出台積電 (TSM-US) 應輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 要求，研擬先進記憶體 3D DRAM 製造計畫，並評估自建新廠或收購既有廠房改建。不過，台積電重申將持續專注專業晶圓代工、服務全球邏輯晶片產業，未證實相關投資。
《Tom’s Hardware》分析，3D DRAM 即使對既有記憶體大廠而言，距離成熟商用仍有多年。台積電若投入，不僅需要建立不同於邏輯晶片的製程能力，還須承擔龐大資本支出與記憶體景氣循環風險，難以藉此解決眼前的供應短缺。
《The Information》6 日引述兩名知情人士報導，台積電應輝達要求，開始規劃 3D DRAM 製造，可能採取興建新廠，或收購現有半導體工廠後改建等方式，但尚未揭露量產時間表。
報導稱，相關計畫由台積電副總經理徐國晉主導。徐國晉負責研究發展及先進封裝技術發展，職掌涵蓋 3D IC 與先進封裝系統整合技術，過去曾擔任台灣美光董事長，具有記憶體產業經驗。
針對傳聞，台積電發言人向《Tom’s Hardware》表示，不評論市場傳聞或臆測，強調公司的核心業務始終是專業晶圓代工，目標是持續成為「全球邏輯晶片」產業，值得信賴的技術與產能供應商。輝達則未立即回應外媒置評請求。
台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 大漲 6.33% 至每股 375.56 美元，折溢價達 15.27%，換算價為 2461.04 元。
華邦電董事長焦佑鈞 7 日表示，跨足 DRAM 必須克服自主技術與專利門檻，考量台積電與記憶體業者已有緊密合作，他評估台積電自行投入 DRAM 產品開發的可能性不高。他認為，台積電若決定投入，會在技術準備成熟後才對外說明，但強調相關看法屬個人推測，並未向業者求證。
3D DRAM 與 HBM 不同　難解短期缺貨
技術上，本文所指的 3D DRAM 與目前 AI 市場大量採用的高頻寬記憶體 (HBM)，雖然都涉及垂直堆疊，堆疊的層級卻不同。HBM 主要將多顆 DRAM 晶粒堆疊並互連；3D DRAM 則是在記憶體製造架構中，將記憶單元向垂直方向配置，以提高單位面積的容量。
這項差異意味著，台積電既有的先進封裝能力，不能直接等同於具備 3D DRAM 製造技術。
DRAM 與邏輯晶片需要不同的製程能力，而 3D DRAM 還須解決多層記憶單元的製造、缺陷控制與良率問題。美光、三星及 SK 海力士均在開發相關技術，但距離成熟商用仍有一段路；以美光為例，其技術規劃仍包括持續推進多代平面 DRAM 製程。
該媒體判斷，台積電即使投入相關開發，也難以在至少五年內藉此緩解目前的記憶體短缺，顯示這類布局更偏向長期技術與產能規劃。
收購仍須長期投資　跨足製造牽動合作關係
《Tom’s Hardware》分析，收購具有自有晶圓廠的特殊型記憶體業者，可能讓台積電取得部分技術、人才與智慧財產，降低從零起步的難度。但小型業者通常不具備最先進的大宗 DRAM 製程，後續仍可能需要數十億美元及多年研發投入，才能建立具競爭力的技術。
投資風險也不僅限於技術。記憶體缺貨與價格上漲往往刺激擴產，但當新增產能集中開出，又可能造成供過於求，壓低價格與獲利，使投資回收面臨不確定性。
此外，台積電若自行製造 DRAM，也可能改變與既有合作夥伴的關係。
SK 海力士於 2024 年宣布與台積電合作，規劃將台積電先進邏輯製程用於 HBM4 的邏輯基底晶片；若台積電進一步跨入記憶單元製造，雙方可能同時存在合作與競爭關係。
HBM 基底晶片、先進封裝　仍可分享記憶體商機
台積電仍可透過生產 HBM 邏輯基底晶片、運用 SoIC 混合鍵合技術整合記憶體與處理器，以及攜手創意與既有 DRAM 業者開發客製化方案，提高在先進記憶體供應鏈中的附加價值。
這些途徑可延伸台積電既有的邏輯製程與先進封裝優勢，同時降低自行建立完整 DRAM 製程及新建晶圓廠的資金負擔，讓公司持續分享 AI 記憶體需求成長帶來的商機。
paras_en: Market rumors suggest that TSMC (TSM-US) is being asked by Nvidia (NVDA-US) to develop an advanced 3D DRAM memory manufacturing plan and to evaluate building a new fab or acquiring an existing plant for conversion. However, TSMC reiterated that it will continue to focus on professional wafer foundry services for the global logic chip industry and has not confirmed any such investment.

Tom’s Hardware analysis notes that even for established memory manufacturers, 3D DRAM is still several years away from mature commercial deployment. If TSMC were to enter the space, it would need to build process capabilities distinct from logic chips, shoulder massive capital expenditures, and bear the cyclical risks of the memory market, making it unlikely to solve the current supply shortage quickly.

The Information reported on the 6th, citing two insiders, that TSMC, at Nvidia’s request, has begun planning 3D DRAM production and may consider either building a new fab or acquiring and retrofitting an existing semiconductor plant, though no mass‑production timeline has been disclosed.

The report says the effort is led by TSMC Vice President Xu Guojin, who oversees R&D and advanced packaging technology, covering 3D IC and advanced packaging system integration. Xu previously served as chairman of Micron Technology Taiwan and brings memory‑industry experience.

When asked about the rumors, a TSMC spokesperson told Tom’s Hardware that the company does not comment on market speculation and emphasized that its core business remains professional wafer foundry, aiming to remain a trusted technology and capacity supplier for the global logic chip industry. Nvidia did not immediately respond to media inquiries.
TSMC ADR (TSM-US) surged 6.33% to $375.56 per share, a premium of 15.27%, equivalent to a price of NT$2,461.04.

WPG Holdings chairman Jiao Youjun said on the 7th that entering DRAM would require overcoming proprietary technology and patent barriers. Given TSMC’s close ties with memory makers, he judges the likelihood of TSMC independently developing DRAM products as low. He believes that if TSMC decides to invest, it would announce it only after the technology is mature, but stresses that his view is personal speculation and not verified with the company.
3D DRAM differs from HBM and does not solve short‑term shortages

Technically, the 3D DRAM discussed in this article differs from the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) widely used in AI today. While both involve vertical stacking, the stacking hierarchy is different: HBM stacks multiple DRAM dies and interconnects them, whereas 3D DRAM arranges memory cells vertically within the memory architecture to increase capacity per unit area.
This distinction means TSMC’s existing advanced‑packaging capabilities cannot be directly equated with 3D DRAM manufacturing technology.

DRAM and logic chips require different process capabilities, and 3D DRAM also must address multi‑layer cell fabrication, defect control, and yield challenges. Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix are all developing related technologies, but commercial maturity is still some way off; for example, Micron’s roadmap still includes continued advancement of planar DRAM generations.

The media judges that even if TSMC invests in development, it is unlikely to alleviate the current memory shortage within at least five years, indicating that such a move is more of a long‑term technology and capacity planning effort.
Acquisitions still require long‑term investment and affect partnership dynamics

Tom’s Hardware analysis suggests that acquiring a specialty memory company with its own fab could give TSMC access to some technology, talent and IP, reducing the difficulty of starting from scratch. However, smaller players usually lack the most advanced high‑volume DRAM processes, and significant billions of dollars and years of R&D would still be needed to build competitive capability.

Investment risk is not limited to technology. Memory shortages and price spikes often spur capacity expansion, but when new capacity comes online simultaneously, oversupply can depress prices and margins, making payback uncertain.
Moreover, if TSMC were to manufacture DRAM itself, it could alter its relationships with existing partners.

SK Hynix announced in 2024 a collaboration with TSMC to use TSMC’s advanced logic process for the logic base chip of HBM4; if TSMC later moves into memory‑cell production, the two companies could find themselves both cooperating and competing.
HBM base chips and advanced packaging can still share memory‑market opportunities

TSMC can continue to produce HBM logic base chips, employ SoIC hybrid bonding to integrate memory and processors, and work with creative and existing DRAM firms on custom solutions, enhancing its value in the advanced memory supply chain.

These pathways extend TSMC’s existing logic‑process and advanced‑packaging strengths while reducing the financial burden of building a full DRAM process and new fab, allowing the company to keep sharing the business opportunities driven by growing AI memory demand.

items.title: 台積電傳進軍3D DRAM市場！輝達要求布局、AI記憶體短缺推升擴產需求
items.title_en: TSMC Said to Eye Entry into 3D DRAM Market; Nvidia Pushes for Deployment, AI Memory Shortage Drives Expansion Demand
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）熱潮持續推升記憶體需求，晶片供應短缺問題日益嚴重。外媒披露，台積電(2330-TW、TSM-US) 正評估跨足先進記憶體晶片市場，考慮投入生產3D動態隨機存取記憶體（3D DRAM），據傳是應輝達(NVDA-US) 要求而起。若計畫成真，台積電將從現有的邏輯晶片代工業務，進一步延伸至記憶體領域，在AI硬體供應鏈扮演更關鍵的角色。
根據《The Information》周五（6日）報導，台積電正評估生產先進記憶體晶片的可行性，並將3D DRAM列為主要技術方向。這項技術被視為記憶體產業的尖端發展方向，與台積電既有的先進製程技術也具有一定協同空間。
台積電目前是輝達AI處理器的主要代工廠，若進一步承接記憶體晶片生產，將使其業務範圍從邏輯晶片延伸至記憶體，有助輝達等AI客戶更全面掌握未來晶片供應情況，也可能在中長期緩解市場供應壓力。
不過，台積電目前尚未承諾投入相關生產。《The Information》也未披露具體時程、投資規模或預計產能。
這波晶片短缺已對全球主要設備製造商的利潤率造成明顯壓力，也推高蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone、索尼(SONY-US) PlayStation等消費電子產品的終端售價。
供應緊張的原因之一，是AI基礎設施建設熱潮帶動高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求大幅增加。
中國大陸記憶體大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 同樣計畫擴大產能。若台積電進一步進軍記憶體市場，將為全球記憶體產業帶來新的競爭變數。
除了供應鏈壓力，AI產業後續投資動能也面臨不確定性。美國民主黨本周在國會兩院選舉中取得全面勝利後，AI企業與投資人開始關注，未來是否可能出現限制資料中心建設的政策措施，進而拖慢AI基礎設施投資，甚至引發市場對AI泡沫的疑慮。
另一方面，台積電股價本周也隨台灣加權股價指數（TAIEX）大幅走跌。加權指數周五盤中一度重挫近9%，進入熊市區間，創下2001年以來最差單周表現。
paras_en: The global AI boom continues to lift memory demand, and chip supply shortages are becoming increasingly severe. Foreign media disclosed that TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) is evaluating a move into the advanced memory chip market, considering production of 3D dynamic random‑access memory (3D DRAM), reportedly at the request of Nvidia (NVDA‑US). If the plan materializes, TSMC would extend its existing logic chip foundry business into the memory sector, playing a more critical role in the AI hardware supply chain.

According to a report by The Information on Friday (the 6th), TSMC is assessing the feasibility of producing advanced memory chips and has listed 3D DRAM as a primary technology focus. This technology is seen as a cutting‑edge development direction for the memory industry and offers some synergy with TSMC’s existing advanced process technologies.

TSMC is currently the main foundry for Nvidia’s AI processors; taking on memory chip production would broaden its business from logic chips to memory, helping Nvidia and other AI customers gain a more comprehensive grasp of future chip supply and potentially easing market supply pressure in the medium to long term.
However, TSMC has not yet committed to related production. The Information also did not disclose a specific timeline, investment scale, or expected capacity.

This wave of chip shortages has already put noticeable pressure on profit margins of major equipment manufacturers worldwide and has pushed up the end‑user prices of consumer electronics such as Apple (AAPL‑US) iPhones and Sony (SONY‑US) PlayStation consoles.
One reason for the tight supply is the surge in demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) driven by the AI infrastructure construction boom.

China’s major memory maker ChangXin Technology (688825‑CN) is also planning to expand capacity. If TSMC moves further into the memory market, it would introduce a new competitive variable to the global memory industry.

Beyond supply‑chain pressure, the AI industry’s subsequent investment momentum also faces uncertainty. After the U.S. Democratic Party’s sweeping victories in both houses of Congress this week, AI firms and investors are watching whether policies could emerge that restrict data‑center construction, potentially slowing AI infrastructure investment and even sparking doubts about an AI bubble.

Meanwhile, TSMC’s stock price this week fell sharply along with the Taiwan Weighted Index (TAIEX). The index plunged nearly 9% intraday on Friday, entering bear‑market territory and recording its worst weekly performance since 2001.

items.title: SpaceX董事會重大異動！Google高層哈里森任職逾10年請辭、馬斯克曝Alphabet利益衝突
items.title_en: SpaceX Board Major Changes! Google Executive Harrison Resigns After Over 10 Years, Musk Reveals Alphabet Conflict of Interest
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 董事會出現重大人事異動，Google(GOOGL-US) 全球合作與企業發展總裁哈里森（Donald Harrison）在任職逾10年後辭去董事職務，並於11月4日生效。SpaceX執行長馬斯克隨後在社群平台X表示，哈里森是因涉及Google母公司Alphabet的利益衝突過多，才決定退出董事會。
根據《Investing.com》報導，SpaceX週五（6日）公布的監管文件披露，哈里森已於11月4日通知公司辭職，且即刻生效。文件指出，這項人事異動並非源於他與公司在營運、政策或實務方面存在任何分歧。
馬斯克隨後在X發文解釋，哈里森面臨太多與Alphabet相關的利益衝突，但也肯定他在SpaceX董事會任職期間的貢獻，並對其服務表達感謝。
哈里森目前擔任Google全球合作與企業發展總裁，是公司高階主管之一，負責管理合作夥伴關係及推動策略性商業計畫。
Alphabet是SpaceX的重要投資者。根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，Alphabet是SpaceX最大的單一機構股東。
Google週五另行披露，持有的SpaceX股份已增至約5.55億股，高於先前的約5.512 億股，顯示哈里森請辭之際，Alphabet對SpaceX的持股仍在增加。
不過，目前公布的資料並未顯示，這項董事會人事異動會影響兩家公司之間的投資關係。
SpaceX業務版圖正不斷擴大，涵蓋火箭發射、衛星通訊及人工智慧（AI）等領域。馬斯克表示，Alphabet持有SpaceX大量股份，加上哈里森在Google擔任高階主管，導致兩家公司之間出現利益重疊。
SpaceX並未具體說明，執行長所指的利益衝突涉及哪些交易、商業合作安排或董事會決策。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) announced a major board personnel change: Donald Harrison, Google’s (GOOGL‑US) President of Global Partnerships and Corporate Development, resigned from the board after more than ten years of service, effective November 4. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk later posted on X that Harrison stepped down because of excessive conflicts of interest involving Alphabet, Google’s parent company.

According to a report from Investing.com, regulatory filings released by SpaceX on Friday (the 6th) show that Harrison notified the company of his resignation on November 4, with immediate effect. The documents state that the change was not due to any operational, policy, or practical disagreements with the company.

Musk subsequently explained on X that Harrison faced too many Alphabet‑related conflicts of interest, but also praised his contributions while serving on SpaceX’s board and thanked him for his service.

Harrison currently serves as Google’s President of Global Partnerships and Corporate Development, one of the firm’s senior executives responsible for managing partner relationships and driving strategic business initiatives.
Alphabet is a major investor in SpaceX. LSEG data indicate that Alphabet is SpaceX’s largest single institutional shareholder.

Google disclosed on Friday that its stake in SpaceX had risen to roughly 555 million shares, up from about 551.2 million shares previously, showing that Alphabet’s holding continued to increase even as Harrison stepped down.
However, the information released so far does not indicate that this board change will affect the investment relationship between the two companies.

SpaceX’s business scope is continually expanding, covering rocket launches, satellite communications and artificial intelligence (AI). Musk said that Alphabet’s large stake in SpaceX, combined with Harrison’s senior role at Google, creates overlapping interests between the two firms.
SpaceX did not specify which transactions, commercial collaborations or board decisions Musk was referring to when he mentioned the conflict of interest.

items.title: 美民主黨掌控國會難撼川普關稅政策！電動車補貼、AI監管成新焦點
paras: 美國民主黨在美國期中選舉中取得重大勝利，國會權力版圖出現變化，也讓全球企業重新評估美國產業政策走向。不過，儘管民主黨掌握國會參眾兩院，川普政府的關稅政策及對中國的管制措施，預料仍將延續；相較之下，電動車等減碳扶持政策則可能重新成為政策辯論焦點，牽動企業在美投資布局。
根據《日經》報導，川普政府實施的關稅政策，已對全球汽車等產業造成沉重成本，不僅壓縮企業獲利，也因進口成本上升推高美國國內物價，增加消費者負擔，相關批評聲浪持續累積。
不過，報導認為，即使民主黨在此次期中選舉中拿下國會參眾兩院，關稅政策也不太可能因此出現重大轉向。
關鍵在於，目前實施的關稅措施主要依據美國《1974年貿易法》第301條及《1962年貿易擴展法》第232條等既有法律授權推動，美國政府仍掌握相當大的執行空間。
以第301條為例，該條款也是美國對等關稅替代措施的法律依據。儘管政府須向國會報告並進行協商，但啟動關稅措施的權限仍掌握在政府手中。
分析認為，民主黨將把關稅調整列為下一屆國會的重要議題，但即使試圖修法限縮總統在關稅政策上的權限，仍可能遭遇美國總統川普行使總統否決權的阻礙。
牛津經濟研究院（Oxford Economics）經濟學家Bernard Yaros指出，關稅已成為聯邦政府重要的財政收入來源，現行稅率要大幅調降並不容易。
日本企業因此仍須以關稅措施持續實施為前提，規劃在美國的生產與採購體系。

AI、資料中心監管與國安政策受關注

除了貿易政策，以國家安全為核心的產業政策也預計不會出現根本性改變。
市場關注焦點之一，是決定美國國防政策及預算基本框架的《國防授權法案》（NDAA），其中涵蓋造船、人工智慧（AI）、半導體及關鍵礦物等經濟安全領域，可能為日本企業參與美國政府在AI與半導體領域的採購創造更多機會。
日本貿易振興機構（JETRO）理事長石黑憲彥表示，無論選舉結果如何，美國政策的大方向都不會改變。他也指出，近期日美關係的一項變化，是軍民兩用技術及國防相關企業之間的洽談增加。
另一方面，AI資料中心的電力消耗及對周邊地區造成的負擔日益受到關注。隨著民主黨掌握國會，針對資料中心電力成本及設置地點的監管措施可能趨於嚴格。

電動車補貼可能重回政策辯論

民主黨掌握國會後，電動車及其他減碳扶持政策可能迎來變化。此前在預算及稅制協商中遭到縮減甚至取消的相關補貼，可能重新成為政策討論焦點；若補貼恢復，也將影響日本車廠對美投資及產品布局。
美國汽車業近年持續因應川普政府政策轉變，包括汽車關稅增加，以及拜登政府時期擴大的電動車扶持措施遭到縮減。各大車廠一方面擴充美國本土產能，另一方面重新調整電動車發展策略。本田便已中止原定在北美推出的3款電動車研發計畫。
儘管美國政策方向存在變數，日本車廠仍持續加碼當地投資。豐田位於肯塔基州的主要工廠，目前生產市場需求強勁的油電混合車（HV）等車款，並持續導入最新生產線，為擴大產能做準備。
豐田2025年11月宣布，未來5年將在美國追加最高100億美元投資。肯塔基工廠負責人David Fernandes表示，公司過去也曾面對各種地緣政治挑戰，重要的是始終堅守基本原則。

汽車、機器人對中管制持續擴大

此外，在國家安全相關的重點產業中，美國降低對中國依賴的政策方向也難以改變。
隨著聯網汽車普及，美國政府日益警惕與中國有關的車輛及車載軟體可能造成資料外洩風險，相關監管措施持續加強。
美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）今年7月也將外國高階機器人納入管制清單，範圍不僅包括自主移動機器人，還涵蓋人形機器人及四足機器人。
分析指出，對日本企業而言，值得注意的是，美國管制範圍已不再侷限於最終產品，而是開始延伸至供應鏈內部。
除了在中國生產的成品，若供應美國市場的產品所使用的中國製零組件、軟體及原材料也被納入監管，企業將不得不重新檢視採購來源與產品設計。

items.title: 特斯拉AI晶片藍圖曝光！Dojo D3導入HBM、SI6效能拚提升80倍、採2奈米製程
items.title_en: Tesla AI Chip Blueprint Revealed! Dojo D3 Uses HBM, SI6 Targets 80× Performance Boost, 2‑nm Process
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US) 公布最新人工智慧（AI）加速器發展藍圖，揭露未來數年晶片研發方向。其中，第六代推論加速器SI6預計將於2029年至2030年推出，運算效能較現行第四代晶片提升80倍，記憶體容量也將大幅增加；另一方面，重新啟動的第三代Dojo訓練加速器D3，則將改採多晶粒（Chiplet）設計，結合2.5D、3D封裝技術及堆疊式高頻寬記憶體（HBM），不再沿用前兩代以SRAM為核心的架構。
根據《Tom’s Hardware》報導，特斯拉也開始以「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence，SI）取代人工智慧（AI）稱呼新一代加速器，並將晶片重新命名為SI系列。
執行長馬斯克近期也證實，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 旗下SpaceXAI將更名為SpaceXSI。

Dojo D3重新登場　轉向多晶粒與HBM架構

特斯拉Dojo訓練晶片計畫再度出現在發展藍圖中。馬斯克2025年8月曾取消整個晶圓級Dojo專案，2026年8月又表示，SpaceX與xAI將在地面及太空資料中心全面採用輝達(NVDA-US) 硬體。
最新藍圖顯示，特斯拉仍規劃推出第三代Dojo D3，但設計將與前兩代大不相同。
特斯拉指出，D3將採用多晶粒架構，整合2.5D與3D封裝技術，並搭配堆疊式HBM。這與第一代Dojo D1的晶圓級系統整合（System-on-Wafer）設計形成明顯差異。D1透過晶圓級封裝技術，將25顆D1處理器互連，整合約11GB SRAM，仰賴分散式晶片內記憶體運作。
報導指出，改用HBM，反映特斯拉可能希望大幅擴充記憶體容量。隨著AI模型規模持續擴大，模型參數、啟動值及中間運算資料都需要大量記憶體儲存，SRAM在容量方面的限制也愈發明顯。
HBM則有助於擴充記憶體，但在延遲、頻寬、封裝及功耗方面，也會帶來不同的設計取捨。
目前尚不清楚特斯拉是否完全放棄晶圓級整合。理論上，客製化HBM仍可堆疊在透過晶圓級封裝互連的邏輯晶粒上，但這種設計將增加散熱、製造、良率及長期可靠性等挑戰，也會推高成本。
由於晶圓級整合本身成本高昂，若再結合HBM堆疊，設計與製造複雜度將進一步增加，因此D3採用較傳統多晶粒架構的可能性相對較高。
特斯拉尚未公布D3的運算效能、記憶體容量、製造製程或開發時程。不過，該公司表示，Dojo D3將針對「太空、訓練及規模擴展」進行最佳化，代表該晶片將具備一定的運算效能，且易於擴充，也進一步顯示其設計可能採用較傳統的加速器架構，而非晶圓級封裝技術。
更值得注意的是，D3也將針對外太空部署環境進行最佳化，這可能代表至少部分產品型號將採用抗輻射強化設計。

SI6運算效能拚80倍　預計2029至2030年問世

另一項重要進展，是特斯拉首次揭露第六代推論加速器SI6的預估效能。根據最新藍圖，SI6的運算能力將達現行第四代晶片HW4的80倍，記憶體容量則為HW4的9倍。
依據HW4運算效能的不同估算方式，SI6的運算效能可能介於17,280至46,080 TOPS（每秒兆次運算），相當於17.28至46.08 POPS（每秒千兆次運算）。不過，目前尚不清楚SI6支援哪些資料格式，因此上述數字只是推估值。
作為比較，輝達Rubin GPU的推論效能達50 NVFP4 PFLOPS，訓練效能為35 NVFP4 PFLOPS，FP8／FP6效能則為17.5 PFLOPS。不過，Rubin已開始出貨，SI6則預計要到2029年至2030年才會推出，兩者上市時程存在明顯差距。
目前特斯拉車款搭載的第四代推論處理器，最初稱為HW4，之後更名為AI4，現又改稱SI4。
該晶片由三星晶圓代工採用7奈米級製程生產，使用傳統覆晶球柵陣列（FCBGA）封裝，並推測搭載16GB GDDR6記憶體。特斯拉將其視為現行全自動輔助駕駛（FSD）技術的效能基準。
然而，特斯拉並未正式公布該晶片的實際運算效能、記憶體容量及功耗，因此外界難以進行精確比較。
由於特斯拉未公開HW4的運算效能、記憶體容量及功耗，外界只能透過既有資訊推估。馬斯克曾表示，HW4效能約為前一代HW3的3至8倍，而HW3官方規格為72 TOPS，據此推算，HW4效能約為216至576 TOPS。

SI5先行導入多晶粒設計　SI6採2奈米製程

在SI6推出之前，特斯拉預計先推出第五代推論加速器SI5，也就是先前稱為HW5或AI5的晶片。該晶片將分別由台積電(2330-TW) 及三星(005930KS) 採用3奈米級與2奈米級製程生產，並導入多晶片模組（MCM）設計，改變HW4採用的傳統封裝方式。
特斯拉預期SI5效能將達HW4的40倍。馬斯克曾表示，這項提升來自運算能力增加8倍，以及透過矽晶最佳化再提升5倍。若以HW4估算效能為基準，SI5運算能力約為8,640至23,040 TOPS。
SI5的功耗預計介於250至800瓦，實際數值將依應用情境而異，因此現階段難以進一步準確估算其效能表現。記憶體容量則預計達96GB，為前一代的6倍；若採用GDDR6或GDDR7記憶體，頻寬可能介於768GB/s至1.536TB/s。
至於第六代推論加速器SI6，特斯拉預計進一步將運算效能提升至HW4的80倍，記憶體容量則達現行處理器的8倍。依據HW4效能的不同估算方式，SI6的運算效能可能達17.28至46.08 POPS（每秒千兆次運算），記憶體容量則為144GB。
特斯拉已與三星晶圓代工簽署合作協議，委由三星生產第六代推論加速器，合作期限至2033年。最新簡報也顯示，SI6將採用2奈米級製程。
考慮到SI6預計於2029年至2030年推出，以及三星最新公布的晶圓代工製程藍圖，相關製程可能包括車用級SF2A、效能強化版SF2P，甚至具備背面供電技術的SF2Z。
值得注意的是，特斯拉目前並未規劃在2030年代透過Terafab採用英特爾(INTC-US) 14A製程生產SI6。封裝方面，SI6將延續SI5的多晶片模組設計，藉此沿用第五代晶片累積的技術經驗，同時控制封裝成本。
隨著AI模型對運算及記憶體需求持續攀升，多晶粒架構與HBM也逐漸成為車廠規劃下一代系統級封裝（SiP）的技術選項。不過，這類設計也將推高晶片成本。至於特斯拉何時會在推論加速器導入HBM，目前仍未有明確時間表，但SI6可能還不會導入這項技術。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) unveiled its latest artificial intelligence (AI) accelerator roadmap, revealing the chip development direction for the coming years. The sixth‑generation inference accelerator, SI6, is slated for launch in 2029‑2030 and is expected to deliver 80 times the compute performance of the current fourth‑generation chip, with a dramatically larger memory capacity. Meanwhile, the revived third‑generation Dojo training accelerator D3 will adopt a chiplet design, combining 2.5D and 3D packaging with stacked high‑bandwidth memory (HBM), abandoning the SRAM‑centric architecture of the first two generations.

According to Tom’s Hardware, Tesla is also beginning to refer to the new generation of accelerators as “Super Intelligence” (SI) instead of artificial intelligence (AI), renaming the chips as the SI series.
CEO Elon Musk recently confirmed that SpaceX’s (SPCX-US) SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI.

Dojo D3 Returns, Shifts to Chiplet and HBM Architecture
Tesla’s Dojo training chip project reappears in the roadmap. Musk cancelled the wafer‑level Dojo project in August 2025, and in August 2026 said SpaceX and xAI will use NVIDIA (NVDA-US) hardware across ground and space data centers.
The latest roadmap shows Tesla still plans to launch a third‑generation Dojo D3, but its design will be markedly different from the first two generations.

Tesla notes that D3 will use a chiplet architecture, integrating 2.5D and 3D packaging with stacked HBM. This contrasts sharply with the first‑generation Dojo D1’s system‑on‑wafer design, which interlinked 25 D1 processors on a wafer, integrating about 11 GB of SRAM and relying on distributed on‑chip memory.

The report points out that switching to HBM suggests Tesla wants to vastly expand memory capacity. As AI models grow, parameters, activation values and intermediate data require massive storage, and SRAM’s capacity limits become increasingly evident.
HBM helps expand memory but also introduces trade‑offs in latency, bandwidth, packaging and power consumption.

It remains unclear whether Tesla will completely abandon wafer‑level integration. In theory, custom HBM could still be stacked on logic chiplets connected via wafer‑level packaging, but this would raise challenges in thermal management, manufacturing yield, long‑term reliability and cost.
Because wafer‑level integration is already expensive, adding HBM stacking would further increase design and manufacturing complexity, making a more traditional chiplet approach for D3 more likely.

Tesla has not disclosed D3’s compute performance, memory capacity, manufacturing process or development schedule. However, the company says Dojo D3 will be optimized for “space, training and scale‑out,” indicating the chip will have respectable compute capability, be easily expandable, and likely use a more conventional accelerator architecture rather than wafer‑level packaging.
Notably, D3 will also be optimized for deployment in outer space, which may mean at least some product variants will feature radiation‑hardened designs.

SI6 Performance Targets an 80× Leap, Expected 2029‑2030 Release
Another key development is Tesla’s first disclosure of the projected performance of the sixth‑generation inference accelerator SI6. The roadmap estimates SI6 will deliver 80 times the compute power of the current fourth‑generation chip HW4, with nine times the memory capacity.

Depending on the methodology used to estimate HW4’s performance, SI6’s compute capability could range from 17,280 to 46,080 TOPS (trillion operations per second), equivalent to 17.28‑46.08 POPS (quadrillion operations per second). The exact data formats SI6 will support are unknown, so these figures are only estimates.

For comparison, NVIDIA’s Rubin GPU offers 50 NVFP4 PFLOPS of inference performance and 35 NVFP4 PFLOPS for training, with FP8/FP6 performance of 17.5 PFLOPS. Rubin is already shipping, whereas SI6 is not expected until 2029‑2030, creating a clear gap in market timing.
Tesla’s current fourth‑generation inference processor, originally called HW4, was later renamed AI4 and is now referred to as SI4.

The chip is fabricated by Samsung on a 7‑nm process, uses a traditional flip‑chip ball grid array (FCBGA) package, and is believed to be equipped with 16 GB of GDDR6 memory. Tesla treats it as the performance baseline for its full‑self‑driving (FSD) system.
However, Tesla has not officially published the actual compute performance, memory capacity or power draw of this chip, making precise external comparisons difficult.

Because Tesla has not disclosed HW4’s performance, memory or power figures, estimates rely on existing information. Musk has said HW4 is roughly 3‑to‑8× the performance of the prior HW3, which was specified at 72 TOPS, implying HW4 delivers about 216‑576 TOPS.

SI5 Introduces Chiplet Design Ahead of SI6’s 2‑nm Process
Before SI6’s launch, Tesla plans to release a fifth‑generation inference accelerator, SI5, previously known as HW5 or AI5. The chip will be produced by TSMC (2330‑TW) and Samsung (005930KS) on 3‑nm and 2‑nm processes respectively, and will adopt a multi‑chip‑module (MCM) design, moving away from HW4’s traditional packaging.

Tesla expects SI5’s performance to be 40× that of HW4. Musk said this gain comes from an eight‑fold increase in compute capability plus a five‑fold boost from silicon optimization. Using HW4’s estimated performance as a baseline, SI5 would deliver roughly 8,640‑23,040 TOPS.

SI5’s power consumption is projected at 250‑800 W, varying with use case, so precise performance estimates are currently unavailable. Memory capacity is expected to reach 96 GB—six times the prior generation—and, if GDDR6 or GDDR7 is used, bandwidth could range from 768 GB/s to 1.536 TB/s.

For the sixth‑generation accelerator SI6, Tesla aims to push compute performance to 80× HW4 and memory capacity to eight times the current processor. Based on HW4’s various performance estimates, SI6 could achieve 17.28‑46.08 POPS of compute and 144 GB of memory.
Tesla has signed a partnership with Samsung to fabricate the sixth‑generation accelerator, with the agreement running through 2033. The latest briefing also shows SI6 will be built on a 2‑nm process.

Given SI6’s planned 2029‑2030 launch and Samsung’s recently announced fab roadmap, the process could be the automotive‑grade SF2A, the performance‑enhanced SF2P, or even the back‑power‑delivery SF2Z variant.

It is worth noting that Tesla does not plan to use Intel’s (INTC-US) 14A process via Terafab for SI6 production in the 2030s. For packaging, SI6 will continue the multi‑chip‑module approach introduced with SI5, leveraging the fifth‑generation’s technical experience while keeping package costs down.

As AI models’ compute and memory demands keep climbing, chiplet architectures and HBM are becoming attractive options for automakers’ next‑generation system‑in‑package (SiP) strategies. However, such designs will raise chip costs. Tesla has not set a timeline for introducing HBM into its inference accelerators, and SI6 is unlikely to incorporate the technology.

items.title: 反彈恐是死貓跳？財經名嘴示警AI融資疑慮未除 CoreWeave、Nebius下周財報是關鍵考驗
items.title_en: Is the Bounce Just a Dead Cat Jump? Financial TV Host Warns AI Financing Concerns Remain; CoreWeave and Nebius Earnings Next Week Are Crucial Tests
paras: 民主黨在期中選舉大勝之後，人工智慧(AI)發展恐遇阻力的擔憂重擊AI行情，《CNBC》財經節目主持人Jim Cramer周五(6日)表示，下周主要新興雲端業者(neoclouds)公布財報，可能考驗投資人對近期重挫的資料中心概念股的信心。
美股在動盪選舉周結束前反彈收高，民主黨拿下眾議院、參議院及幾個重要州長席次後，投資人大舉拋售與AI基礎設施相關個股。
Cramer表示，周五的漲勢雖令人欣慰，但考量到華爾街前一日才經歷19個月來最慘烈的單日跌勢，卻還不足以令人放心。他對市場是否真正復甦仍抱持懷疑，正如他先前也不看好周三那波選後單日大漲行情，最終證明曇花一現。
Cramer在《Mad Money》節目中談到周五市場普遍上漲的行情時說，資料中心支出與融資方面的疑慮仍未獲得解決，「這感覺就像死貓反彈。我知道我們永遠不可能得到全面解除警報的訊號，但我仍覺得市場上有不少賣家伺機而動，只等股價進一步反彈，就趁機出場。」
他如今把目光轉向下周市場動向，最受市場關注的可能是新興雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)預定下周二盤後公布的財報。
Cramer表示，這家借貸龐大的新創必須向投資人說明打算如何為擴張計畫籌資，以及如何管理借款成本。
法盛投資管理投資組合策略師Garrett Melson表示，若CoreWeave高層能在財報會議上說明打算如何籌措資金、完成手上的專案，即使展望只是審慎樂觀，也有助緩解疑慮。
另一家備受矚目的新興雲端業者Nebius(NBIS-US)則將於下周四盤前公布財報，成為CoreWeave之後牽動AI交易的另一項重大考驗。
Cramer表示，投資人將關注Nebius是否取得強勁的新訂單、完成資料中心建置，以及是否擁有充足的未來專案儲備。他說：「我不希望聽到他們正在興建的據點延遲完工，而且超出預算。」
科技股領域，還有網路設備供應商思科(Cisco Systems)(CSCO-US)、半導體設備製造商應用材料(AMAT-US)將公布財報，Cramer建議投資人稍安勿躁，他自己準備先按兵不動，不急著買進。
Cramer說：「記住，我們不在乎一檔股票過去從哪裡來，我們只在乎它接下來要往哪裡去。」
paras_en: After the Democrats’ landslide victory in the midterm elections, worries that AI development could face resistance have hit the AI market hard. CNBC host Jim Cramer said on Friday (the 6th) that next week’s earnings reports from major emerging cloud providers (neoclouds) could test investors’ confidence in data‑center stocks that have recently slumped.

U.S. stocks rebounded and closed higher before the turbulent election week ended, as Democrats secured the House, the Senate, and several key governorships, prompting investors to dump stocks tied to AI infrastructure.

Cramer noted that Friday’s rally was encouraging, but given that Wall Street had just endured its worst single‑day drop in 19 months the day before, it was not enough to feel reassured. He remains skeptical about a true market recovery, recalling how he previously dismissed Wednesday’s post‑election surge, which turned out to be fleeting.

Speaking on his show Mad Money about Friday’s broad market gains, Cramer said concerns over data‑center spending and financing have not been resolved, “It feels like a dead‑cat bounce. I know we’ll never get a full‑clear signal, but I still think there are plenty of sellers waiting for the price to climb a bit more before they jump out.”

He now turns his focus to next week’s market moves, with the most watched event likely being emerging cloud provider CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), which is scheduled to release its earnings after the market closes on Tuesday.
Cramer said the heavily leveraged startup must explain to investors how it plans to fund its expansion and manage borrowing costs.

Garrett Melson, a portfolio strategist at Fasheng Investment Management, added that if CoreWeave’s executives can outline how they will raise capital and complete current projects at the earnings call, even a cautiously optimistic outlook would help ease concerns.
Another highly watched emerging cloud player, Nebius (NBIS‑US), will report earnings before the market opens on Thursday, becoming the next major test for AI‑related trading after CoreWeave.

Cramer said investors will watch whether Nebius secures strong new orders, completes data‑center builds, and has sufficient pipeline of future projects. He warned, “I don’t want to hear that the sites they’re building are delayed or over budget.”

In the tech sector, network‑equipment supplier Cisco Systems (CSCO‑US) and semiconductor‑equipment maker Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) are also set to report earnings. Cramer advises investors to stay calm and says he plans to sit on the sidelines for now, not rushing to buy.
Cramer concluded, “Remember, we don’t care where a stock has come from; we only care where it’s headed next.”

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉國安基金進場對決外資提款 拚年線上築出大盤底部
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Outlook: National Security Fund Enters to Counter Foreign Capital Withdrawals, Aiming to Build Bottom Above the Year Line
paras: 台股上周五經歷史上最黑暗的黑色星期五，造成周跌點多達5510點，跌幅達12%，並跌破40000點整數大關，隨著美股費半指數上周五反彈、台積電ADR也止跌彈升6%，市場期待台股出現低檔支撐，本周將看到國安基金上膛對決外資重手出場以及融資減肥的壓力，法人認為較好情形是在年線之上築出大盤底部。
上周外資在台股集中市場賣超多達5244億元，同時，外資期貨淨空單達99930口，加上新台幣匯率一度貶破33元重要大關，尚未看到外資停下從台股重手提款的訊號。

而外資一周來主要賣超張數前10大標的多為ETF，依序為主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)、元大台灣50(0050-TW)、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)、主動統一升級50(00403A-TW)、群益台灣精選高息(00919-TW)、主動群益科技創新(00992A-TW)、力積電(6770-TW)、台積電(2330-TW)、主動國泰動能高息(00400A-TW)和中信台日韓PCB(009828-TW)。
以金額來看，則是台積電一周來遭外資提款1819億元最多，其次為聯發科(2454-TW)近700億元，元大台灣50達340億元，日月光投控(3711-TW)277億元，欣興(3037-TW)167億元，南亞(1303-TW)逾150億元，台達電(2308-TW)也有140億元。
台股交易員提醒，內資方面同樣有壓，儘管投信撐盤，但面對中實戶主力和散戶尚有5341億元的融資餘額，仍不得不提防反彈有壓、下跌又造成融資斷頭。
不過，台股交易員認為，投資人若無急迫性變現壓力，倒無需過度看壞後市，國安基金已宣布周一進場，此為台股史上第10次護盤，而據統計，過去9次國安基金護盤有8次均為正報酬。
永豐投顧則指出，台股近期重跌，然融資減肥有限，但此次下跌主因美國民主黨大勝後對AI發展路徑投下變數，不能與過去高槓桿操作失誤等量齊觀，目前市場對AI產業前景急劇反轉有極度恐慌，事態未明，先觀望等待。
永豐投顧認為，先等待融資籌碼變化，若出現大幅減少，行情才能反轉，本周指數區間看38000點至40000點。
至於AI科技革命，長線目標不變，是短線投資會受到本益比的衝擊。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced its darkest Black Friday last Friday, dropping 5,510 points—a 12% decline—and falling below the 40,000-point round number. With the US Nasdaq index rebounding and TSMC ADRs snapping a loss to rise 6%, the market is looking for low‑level support. This week will see the National Security Fund loading up to confront heavy foreign outflows and the pressure of margin‑call reductions, and institutions believe the best case is a market bottom forming above the yearly moving average.

Last week foreign investors sold a net NT$5.244 billion in Taiwan's main board, while their net short futures position reached 99,930 contracts. The New Taiwan dollar also briefly slipped past the NT$33 per US$ mark, and there is still no sign that foreign investors are pausing their large‑scale withdrawals from Taiwanese equities.

The top ten securities that foreign investors sold the most over the week were mainly ETFs, in order: Active CTBC Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW), Active Uni‑Taiwan Growth (00981A‑TW), Active Uni‑Upgrade 50 (00403A‑TW), KGI Taiwan Select High‑Yield (00919‑TW), Active KGI Tech Innovation (00992A‑TW), Powerchip (6770‑TW), TSMC (2330‑TW), Active Cathay Momentum High‑Yield (00400A‑TW) and CTBC Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB (009828‑TW).

By dollar amount, TSMC saw the largest foreign outflow last week at NT$181.9 billion, followed by MediaTek (2454‑TW) with nearly NT$70 billion, Yuanta Taiwan 50 at NT$34 billion, ASE Technology Holding (3711‑TW) at NT$27.7 billion, Unimicron (3037‑TW) at NT$16.7 billion, Nan Ya (1303‑TW) over NT$15 billion, and Delta Electronics (2308‑TW) with NT$14 billion.

Taiwan stock traders warn that domestic investors also face pressure. Although mutual funds are providing support, there remains NT$534.1 billion of margin debt from institutional and retail investors, meaning a rebound could be constrained and a further drop might trigger margin calls.

Nevertheless, traders say that if investors are not forced to liquidate urgently, there is no need to be overly pessimistic. The National Security Fund announced it would enter the market on Monday, marking the 10th historic market‑support intervention, and statistics show that eight of the previous nine interventions yielded positive returns.

Yong‑Feng Investment Advisory notes that the recent sharp decline was not driven by margin‑call reductions, but mainly by uncertainty after the U.S. Democratic landslide, which introduced new variables to AI development pathways. This differs from past mistakes tied to high‑leverage trading, and the market is currently panicking over a sudden reversal in AI industry prospects, leaving the situation unclear and prompting a wait‑and‑see stance.
Yong‑Feng expects the market to first watch margin‑position changes; a significant reduction could allow a reversal. This week they forecast the index to trade between 38,000 and 40,000 points.
Regarding the AI technology revolution, the long‑term target remains unchanged, but short‑term investments will be affected by price‑to‑earnings ratios.

items.title: 台積電傳進軍3D DRAM市場！輝達要求布局、AI記憶體短缺推升擴產需求
items.title_en: TSMC Said to Eye Entry into 3D DRAM Market; Nvidia Pushes for Deployment, AI Memory Shortage Drives Expansion Demand
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）熱潮持續推升記憶體需求，晶片供應短缺問題日益嚴重。外媒披露，台積電(2330-TW、TSM-US) 正評估跨足先進記憶體晶片市場，考慮投入生產3D動態隨機存取記憶體（3D DRAM），據傳是應輝達(NVDA-US) 要求而起。若計畫成真，台積電將從現有的邏輯晶片代工業務，進一步延伸至記憶體領域，在AI硬體供應鏈扮演更關鍵的角色。
根據《The Information》周五（6日）報導，台積電正評估生產先進記憶體晶片的可行性，並將3D DRAM列為主要技術方向。這項技術被視為記憶體產業的尖端發展方向，與台積電既有的先進製程技術也具有一定協同空間。
台積電目前是輝達AI處理器的主要代工廠，若進一步承接記憶體晶片生產，將使其業務範圍從邏輯晶片延伸至記憶體，有助輝達等AI客戶更全面掌握未來晶片供應情況，也可能在中長期緩解市場供應壓力。
不過，台積電目前尚未承諾投入相關生產。《The Information》也未披露具體時程、投資規模或預計產能。
這波晶片短缺已對全球主要設備製造商的利潤率造成明顯壓力，也推高蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone、索尼(SONY-US) PlayStation等消費電子產品的終端售價。
供應緊張的原因之一，是AI基礎設施建設熱潮帶動高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求大幅增加。
中國大陸記憶體大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 同樣計畫擴大產能。若台積電進一步進軍記憶體市場，將為全球記憶體產業帶來新的競爭變數。
除了供應鏈壓力，AI產業後續投資動能也面臨不確定性。美國民主黨本周在國會兩院選舉中取得全面勝利後，AI企業與投資人開始關注，未來是否可能出現限制資料中心建設的政策措施，進而拖慢AI基礎設施投資，甚至引發市場對AI泡沫的疑慮。
另一方面，台積電股價本周也隨台灣加權股價指數（TAIEX）大幅走跌。加權指數周五盤中一度重挫近9%，進入熊市區間，創下2001年以來最差單周表現。
paras_en: The global AI boom continues to lift memory demand, and chip supply shortages are becoming increasingly severe. Foreign media disclosed that TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) is evaluating a move into the advanced memory chip market, considering production of 3D dynamic random‑access memory (3D DRAM), reportedly at the request of Nvidia (NVDA‑US). If the plan materializes, TSMC would extend its existing logic chip foundry business into the memory sector, playing a more critical role in the AI hardware supply chain.

According to a report by The Information on Friday (the 6th), TSMC is assessing the feasibility of producing advanced memory chips and has listed 3D DRAM as a primary technology focus. This technology is seen as a cutting‑edge development direction for the memory industry and offers some synergy with TSMC’s existing advanced process technologies.

TSMC is currently the main foundry for Nvidia’s AI processors; taking on memory chip production would broaden its business from logic chips to memory, helping Nvidia and other AI customers gain a more comprehensive grasp of future chip supply and potentially easing market supply pressure in the medium to long term.
However, TSMC has not yet committed to related production. The Information also did not disclose a specific timeline, investment scale, or expected capacity.

This wave of chip shortages has already put noticeable pressure on profit margins of major equipment manufacturers worldwide and has pushed up the end‑user prices of consumer electronics such as Apple (AAPL‑US) iPhones and Sony (SONY‑US) PlayStation consoles.
One reason for the tight supply is the surge in demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) driven by the AI infrastructure construction boom.

China’s major memory maker ChangXin Technology (688825‑CN) is also planning to expand capacity. If TSMC moves further into the memory market, it would introduce a new competitive variable to the global memory industry.

Beyond supply‑chain pressure, the AI industry’s subsequent investment momentum also faces uncertainty. After the U.S. Democratic Party’s sweeping victories in both houses of Congress this week, AI firms and investors are watching whether policies could emerge that restrict data‑center construction, potentially slowing AI infrastructure investment and even sparking doubts about an AI bubble.

Meanwhile, TSMC’s stock price this week fell sharply along with the Taiwan Weighted Index (TAIEX). The index plunged nearly 9% intraday on Friday, entering bear‑market territory and recording its worst weekly performance since 2001.

items.title: 宏致前三季EPS 3.31元 看好AI營收逐季增擬斥14億元購地擴產
items.title_en: Hongzhi Posts Q3 EPS of NT$3.31, Optimistic About Quarterly AI Revenue Growth and Plans NT$1.4 B Land Purchase for Expansion
paras: 連接器廠宏致(3605-TW)第三季稅後純益2.44億元，季增21%、年增9%、每股純益1.42元；累計前三季每股純益3.31元，展望第四季，預期AI相關應用的高速、高功率產品營收占比將穩健擴大，帶動整體AI營收逐季成長。
宏致董事會也通過以交易金額不超過14億元取得桃園市中壢區上嶺段土地及建物，主要是評估台灣現有廠房之營運空間將不敷未來中長期發展使用，為滿足後續營運擴張之需要，擬購置土地以建置新廠房，強化公司整體生產規模。
展望第四季，宏致表示，儘管消費性電子、網通及筆電市場進入傳統淡季，但受惠全球AI伺服器與ASIC(客製化特殊應用晶片)需求強勁，高速連接產品及高功率、高壓電源線等產品出貨動能持續增溫，帶動整體AI營收逐季成長。
宏致第三季營收32.94億元，季增3.06%、年增23.71%、毛利率27.24%，季增0.37個百分點、年減0.15個百分點、營業利益2.70億元，季增9.69%、年增83.72%、營業利益率8.19%，季增0.50個百分點、年增2.68個百分點。
宏致前三季累計營收91.90億元，年增17.91%、毛利率26.66%，年減0.31個百分點、營業利益6.63億元，年增44.34%、營業利益率7.22%，年增1.32個百分點、稅後純益5.52億元，年增4.81%。
paras_en: Connector manufacturer Hongzhi (3605‑TW) reported third‑quarter net profit after tax of NT$244 million, up 21% quarter‑over‑quarter and 9% year‑over‑year, translating to earnings per share of NT$1.42. Cumulative earnings per share for the first three quarters were NT$3.31. Looking ahead to Q4, the company expects the share of revenue from high‑speed, high‑power AI‑related products to expand steadily, driving overall AI revenue to grow quarter by quarter.

The board of directors also approved a purchase of land and buildings in the Shangling area of Zhongli District, Taoyuan City, for a transaction amount not exceeding NT$1.4 billion. The move reflects an assessment that the operating space of existing Taiwanese factories will be insufficient for the company’s medium‑ to long‑term development, and the land will be used to build a new plant to strengthen overall production capacity.

Looking to Q4, Hongzhi said that although the consumer electronics, networking and notebook markets enter their traditional off‑season, strong global demand for AI servers and ASICs (application‑specific integrated circuits) is boosting shipments of high‑speed interconnect products and high‑power, high‑voltage power cables, keeping AI‑related revenue on an upward trajectory each quarter.

In the third quarter, Hongzhi recorded revenue of NT$3.294 billion, up 3.06% quarter‑over‑quarter and 23.71% year‑over‑year, with a gross margin of 27.24% (up 0.37 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, down 0.15 points year‑over‑year). Operating profit was NT$270 million, up 9.69% quarter‑over‑quarter and 83.72% year‑over‑year, yielding an operating margin of 8.19% (up 0.50 points quarter‑over‑quarter and up 2.68 points year‑over‑year).

For the first three quarters, cumulative revenue reached NT$9.190 billion, a 17.91% year‑over‑year increase, with a gross margin of 26.66% (down 0.31 points year‑over‑year). Operating profit was NT$663 million, up 44.34% year‑over‑year, giving an operating margin of 7.22% (up 1.32 points year‑over‑year). Net profit after tax totaled NT$552 million, up 4.81% year‑over‑year.

items.title: 〈華邦電展望〉AI一枝獨秀！擴產效益明年顯現 焦佑鈞示警「擔心下一個不景氣太晚來」
items.title_en: Waveshare Electronics Outlook: AI Stands Out! Expansion Benefits Appear Next Year, CEO Jiao Youjun Warns "Worried the Next Downturn Comes Too Late"
paras: 記憶體大廠華邦電(2344-TW)今(7)日舉行家庭日活動，董事長焦佑鈞表示，當前半導體市場呈現「百業蕭條、一枝獨秀」的奇特格局，全靠 AI 相關應用帶動需求，且僅有 AI 領域能夠承受記憶體價格持續上漲。華邦電擴產效益預計明年起顯現，目前市場普遍預期榮景將能延續至 2028、2029 年，但焦佑鈞吐露業界的隱憂，「我們的擔心是下一個不景氣太晚來！」
焦佑鈞受訪時指出，今年 AI 相關應用一枝獨秀，手機、PC 等終端電子產品銷售力道明顯疲軟，消費者普遍因價格昂貴而選擇延長換機週期。他直言，「我們不能說做 AI 的人把所有的飯都吃了，其他人都不吃飯，這樣不行！」
從社會責任角度來看，他希望記憶體價格不要持續飆漲，因為過度漲價對一般消費者已造成傷害，且毛利率攀升亦有其極限，原廠也會擔心壓抑終端需求。
關於華邦電產能規劃，焦佑鈞透露，公司自去年下半年起啟動擴產計畫，目前相關設備正陸續進廠裝機，預計明年起產出效益將開始明顯展現，後年產能將進一步接近滿載狀態。針對今年完成的英飛凌相關資產併購案，焦佑鈞說明，此案最大的價值在於取得頂尖技術人才與既有的晶圓代工合作關係，能顯著提升華邦電在 AI 世代下開發智慧財產(IP)的能力，並增強客戶服務的彈性。
針對外界擔憂 CSP 業者自由現金流與資本支出可能放緩的問題，焦佑鈞分析，短期內需求依然無虞，因為 2027 年資料中心所需的土地開發許可、電力及廠房建設過去一年均已準備完成，接下來將進入伺服器裝機階段，相關資金也已提前投入，因此 2027 與 2028 年基本上不會受資金影響。
然而，焦佑鈞進一步示警，資金限制將是判斷經濟循環的核心，「如果沒有錢的話，所有投資一定會減緩」，到了 2029 年資金限制恐成為下一個下降循環的主因。
焦佑鈞坦言，兩年前他曾預估這波上升循環約持續兩年(自 2025 年 7 月至 2027 年 6 月)，但現在市場普遍認為熱潮會延續到 2028、2029 年。面對延長的榮景，焦佑鈞吐露業界的隱憂，「我們的擔心是下一個不景氣太晚來！」
他解釋，若景氣好太久，業者往往不知道何時該停下擴產腳步而盲目持續蓋廠，等到景氣反轉時才發現產能過剩，反而會讓後續下行循環帶來的衝擊與衰退深度更為劇烈。
paras_en: Memory chip giant Waveshare Electronics (2344-TW) held a family day event today (the 7th), where Chairman Jiao Youjun said the current semiconductor market shows a peculiar pattern of "overall industry slump, but AI standing out," driven entirely by AI‑related applications, and only the AI sector can bear the continued rise in memory prices. Waveshare expects the benefits of its capacity expansion to materialise starting next year; while the market generally expects the boom to last until 2028‑2029, Jiao voiced an industry concern: "Our worry is that the next recession will come too late!"

In an interview, Jiao noted that AI‑related applications have been the sole bright spot this year, while sales of end‑user electronics such as smartphones and PCs are clearly weakening, with consumers extending device replacement cycles because of high prices. He bluntly said, "We can't say that only the AI players are eating all the food while everyone else goes hungry—that's not right!"

From a corporate‑social‑responsibility perspective, he hopes memory prices will not keep soaring, as excessive price hikes already hurt ordinary consumers, and there is a limit to how much gross margins can rise; manufacturers also worry about suppressing end‑user demand.

Regarding Waveshare's capacity plan, Jiao disclosed that the company launched its expansion program in the second half of last year, and related equipment is being installed sequentially. Production benefits are expected to become evident from next year, with capacity approaching full utilisation the year after. Concerning the Infineon‑related asset acquisition completed this year, Jiao explained that the deal’s greatest value lies in acquiring top‑tier technical talent and existing wafer‑foundry partnerships, which will markedly boost Waveshare’s ability to develop AI‑era intellectual property and enhance flexibility in customer service.

Addressing external concerns that CSP operators’ free cash flow and capex might slow, Jiao analysed that short‑term demand remains secure because land‑use permits, power and factory construction for data centres needed in 2027 were all completed over the past year. The next phase is server installation, with related funding already committed, so 2027‑2028 should not be affected by financing constraints.

However, Jiao warned that funding constraints will become the core gauge of the economic cycle: "If there’s no money, all investment will inevitably slow down," and by 2029 financial limits could become the main driver of the next downturn.

Jiao admitted that two years ago he estimated this upward cycle would last about two years (from July 2025 to June 2027), but the market now broadly believes the boom will extend to 2028‑2029. Facing a prolonged prosperity, he reiterated the industry’s worry: "Our concern is that the next recession will come too late!"

He explained that if the economy stays strong for too long, companies often don’t know when to halt expansion and blindly keep building factories. When the cycle reverses, they discover excess capacity, which can make the subsequent down‑turn and recession much more severe.

items.title: 〈華邦電展望〉焦佑鈞證實員工分紅30個月 談營運「賠錢很煩、賺錢很累」
items.title_en: WPG Holdings Outlook: Chairman Chiao Yu‑chun Confirms Employee Bonus Equivalent to 30 Months’ Salary, Says “Losses Are Annoying, Profits Are Exhausting”
paras: 華邦電(2344-TW)今(7)日舉辦家庭日活動，董事長焦佑鈞受訪時談及股利政策與員工福利，他強調，華邦電早已建立高度透明且制度化的機制，下月將依公司章程規定，將上半年獲利配發每股 2 元現金股利；而員工分紅亦與每季的營業利益連動，今年隨公司獲利大幅成長，員工分紅相當優渥，並證實網路與內部傳出員工平均獎金上看 30 個月的說法。
談到記憶體產業的大起大落，焦佑鈞大方吐露心聲笑稱「賠錢很煩、賺錢很累。」他解釋，賠錢時要想方設法轉虧為盈當然很煩惱；但賺錢時大家都在向前衝、搶人才、搶設備與開發技術，絕對不能因為今年賺錢就鬆懈，「否則過三年就垮了」，因此賺錢時反而更累。
談到股利政策，焦佑鈞強調，華邦電早已建立高度透明且制度化的機制，12 月將依公司章程規定，將上半年獲利配發每股 2 元現金股利。
在員工分紅方面，制度每季固定依營業利益比例提撥，隨今年公司獲利顯著回升，網路傳出員工平均獎金上看 30 個月的說法也獲得證實。焦佑鈞打趣地表示，同仁對分紅制度都很清楚，但常有家屬拿到獎金太開心分享到社群媒體上，因此特別溫馨提醒員工與家屬還是要保持低調。
針對子公司新唐科技(4919-TW)近年營運表現，焦佑鈞透露，新唐先前受制於收購時承接的日本合資晶圓廠產能負擔(持股 49%)，在疫情過後市場需求回落時造成額外財務負擔。目前新唐已與合資夥伴高塔半導體達成協議，確定將於明年 4 月 1 日正式解約，屆時此一虧損包袱將徹底解除，新唐的整體獲利能力與財務結構將迎來顯著改善。
焦佑鈞指出，新唐過去 2 年在經營團隊帶領下已積極轉型，將核心研發資源全面重組並全力衝刺 AI 相關應用領域，相關效益預計將在明、後年陸續展現。
在高層人事分工方面，新唐執行長吳孟奇將全權負責日本廠重整與長遠營運布局；將從新唐退休的董事長蘇源茂則回歸華邦電擔任高階顧問，協助華邦電在記憶體熱潮中推進龐大的投資計畫、產能擴建與國際人才招募，為集團下一階段成長蓄積動能。
paras_en: WPG Holdings (2344‑TW) held a family‑day event today (the 7th). In an interview, Chairman Chiao Yu‑chun discussed the dividend policy and employee benefits, emphasizing that the company has long established a highly transparent and systematic mechanism. Next month, in accordance with the articles of incorporation, a cash dividend of NT$2 per share will be distributed from the first‑half profit; employee profit‑sharing is also linked to quarterly operating profit. With this year’s sharp profit growth, employee bonuses are very generous, and he confirmed the online and internal rumor that the average employee bonus amounts to about 30 months of salary.

When talking about the memory‑chip industry’s boom‑and‑bust cycles, Chiao openly joked, “Losses are annoying, profits are exhausting.” He explained that when the company loses money, it is frustrating to try to turn the loss into profit; but when it makes money, everyone rushes to compete for talent, equipment and technology development, and one cannot become complacent just because this year is profitable—“otherwise you’ll collapse in three years.” Hence, making money can be even more tiring.

Regarding the dividend policy, Chiao stressed again that WPG has long had a highly transparent and systematic mechanism, and in December the company will, as stipulated by its articles of incorporation, distribute a cash dividend of NT$2 per share from the first‑half profit.

On employee profit‑sharing, the system allocates a fixed proportion of quarterly operating profit. With this year’s significant profit rebound, the rumor that the average employee bonus reaches 30 months of salary has been confirmed. Chiao humorously noted that employees understand the bonus system well, but family members often get overly excited and share the news on social media, so he gently reminded everyone to keep a low profile.

Regarding the performance of its subsidiary Xintong Technology (4919‑TW), Chiao revealed that Xintong was previously burdened by the capacity of a Japanese joint‑venture wafer fab (49% stake) acquired during a takeover. After the pandemic, a drop in market demand added extra financial strain. Xintong has now reached an agreement with its joint‑venture partner, Gaota Semiconductor, to terminate the partnership on 1 April next year, which will completely remove this loss‑making burden and markedly improve Xintong’s profitability and financial structure.

Chiao pointed out that over the past two years Xintong, under its management team, has actively transformed, fully reorganizing core R&D resources and focusing on AI‑related applications. The benefits of this shift are expected to materialize gradually over the next two years.

In terms of senior management responsibilities, Xintong’s CEO Wu Meng‑chi will take full charge of the Japanese plant’s restructuring and long‑term operational planning. Retiring Xintong chairman Su Yuan‑mao will return to WPG as a senior advisor, helping the group drive large‑scale investment projects, capacity expansion and international talent recruitment amid the memory‑chip boom, thereby building momentum for the next phase of growth.

items.title: 〈華邦電展望〉晶圓龍頭傳跨足3D DRAM 焦佑鈞：台積追求卓越 不會做半調子
items.title_en: <Wah Boon Electronics Outlook> Wafer Leader Rumored to Enter 3D DRAM; Jiao Youjun: TSMC Pursues Excellence and Won’t Do Half‑Measures
paras: 華邦電(2344-TW)今(7)日舉辦 2026 年度家庭日，晶圓代工龍頭台積電(2330-TW)近期傳出有意為輝達(NVIDIA)生產 3D DRAM，藉此進軍先進記憶體領域，引發半導體供應鏈高度關注。記憶體大廠華邦電董事長焦佑鈞受訪時指出，台積電是一家追求卓越的公司，若真有規劃跨足 DRAM 市場，絕不可能做半吊子，必定會在技術完全成熟前選擇默默進行，不會輕易釋出未準備好的訊息。
焦佑鈞分析，晶圓代工大廠若要跨入 DRAM 領域，首要面臨的正是技術自主與龐大的專利壁壘。DRAM 技術無法憑空而來，企業必須審慎評估是否願意投入鉅額資金進行自主研發，同時還需處理極為複雜的記憶體專利。
此外，台積電目前與三星、華邦電等各大記憶體廠在先進封裝領域均保持緊密的合作關係，在既有生態系合作良好的基礎下，自行跳下來跨界開發 DRAM 產品的可能性並不高。
針對 AI 資料中心資本支出議題，焦佑鈞指出，台積電與整體供應鏈在 2027 至 2028 年的裝機需求極為確定，雲端服務業者(CSP)的前期投資與設備均已到位。
然而，若總體經濟資金限制逐漸顯現，2029 年半導體產業恐迎來下一波景氣調整，屆時先進封裝與記憶體供應鏈的產能配比將成為市場觀察重點。
paras_en: Wah Boon Electronics (2344‑TW) held its 2026 Family Day today (the 7th). Recently, wafer‑foundry giant TSMC (2330‑TW) is rumored to be interested in producing 3D DRAM for NVIDIA, aiming to break into the advanced memory market, which has drawn intense attention across the semiconductor supply chain. In an interview, Wah Boon’s chairman Jiao Youjun said TSMC is a company that strives for excellence; if it truly plans to step into the DRAM market, it would never do a half‑hearted job and would keep any activity under wraps until the technology is fully mature, avoiding the release of unprepared information.

Jiao explained that for a major foundry to enter the DRAM field, the primary challenges are technological independence and massive patent barriers. DRAM technology cannot be invented out of thin air; a company must carefully assess whether it is willing to invest huge sums in independent R&D while also navigating an extremely complex web of memory patents.

Moreover, TSMC already maintains close collaborations with leading memory makers such as Samsung and Wah Boon in the advanced packaging arena. Given the strong existing ecosystem partnerships, the likelihood of TSMC abruptly jumping into DRAM product development on its own is low.

Addressing AI data‑center capital‑expenditure issues, Jiao noted that TSMC and the broader supply chain have a very clear outlook for equipment demand in 2027‑2028, with cloud service providers (CSPs) already having made their upfront investments and secured the necessary equipment.

However, if overall economic financing constraints become more pronounced, the semiconductor industry could face its next cyclical adjustment in 2029. At that point, the capacity balance between advanced packaging and memory supply chains will become a key focus for the market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉華航客貨運業績暢旺 股價創3個月來新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: China Airlines' Passenger and Cargo Operations Thrive, Stock Hits 3-Month High
paras: 華航(2610-TW)第三季暑期客運業績暢旺，第四季又迎來貨運傳統旺季，同時國際油價有望回跌，使本周股價在台股大回檔之際，相對有撐，周漲逾5%，最高來到22.15元創8月以來新高價位。
華航第三季稅後純益44.2億元，年增49.56%，每股純益(EPS)0.72元，創單季第三高紀錄，而前三季稅後純益110.02億元，年增0.05%，EPS 1.8元，儘管面臨高油價，仍有效穩住獲利動能。
展望第四季，華航看好，空運迎來旺季，可望帶動傳產、電商等其他空運主力產品拉貨潮，預估可支撐整體貨運需求續強。
法人分析，明年AI 產業將持續帶動電子產品空運需求，而華航預計新增 4 架 777-F 貨機，空運成長動能可期。
另一方面，在中東戰爭影響逐漸降低下，法人預估明年航空燃油均價將小幅低於今年，有助航空業獲利處成長趨勢。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610-TW) saw strong passenger performance in Q3 summer, and Q4 welcomes the traditional cargo peak season, while international oil prices are expected to fall, giving its stock relative support during a broad market pullback; the stock rose over 5% for the week, reaching a high of NT$22.15, a new peak since August.

China Airlines posted Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$4.42 billion, up 49.56% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$0.72, the third‑quarter highest on record, while net profit for the first three quarters was NT$11.002 billion, up 0.05% YoY, EPS NT$1.80; despite high fuel costs, it effectively maintained profit momentum.

Looking ahead to Q4, the airline is optimistic; air freight enters its peak season and is expected to drive a cargo surge from traditional manufacturers, e‑commerce and other major air‑freight shippers, supporting continued strong overall cargo demand.

Institutional analysts note that the AI industry will continue to boost demand for air transport of electronic products next year, and China Airlines plans to add four 777‑F freighters, giving its cargo growth momentum.

Meanwhile, as the impact of the Middle East war gradually diminishes, analysts forecast that average jet fuel prices next year will be slightly lower than this year, helping the airline industry's profit growth trend.

items.title: 來高雄金融展抽東京機票！公股銀搶進高資產專區 各家專屬優惠一表看

paras: 2026高雄國際金融博覽會11月6至8日高雄展覽館登場，集合國內外金融機構，以ETF投資、TISA帳戶及家族辦公室為三大主軸。公股銀行攜手進駐亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區，兆豐金控 （2886-TW）、第一銀行、臺灣企銀 (2834-TW）、彰化銀行（2801-TW）與土地銀行分別以超跑賽事、港灣意象、工藝美學與AI互動打造沉浸式展區，土銀更祭出抽獎東京來回機票及Apple Watch等活動，搶攻普惠金融與高端財富管理商機。

兆豐金控今年以「兆豐財富超跑賽」為主題，集結兆豐銀行、兆豐投信、兆豐證券及兆豐期貨四大事業體。現場展示機器人理財「理財e把兆」、美股盤前交易與每股GO服務、兆期Pro策略交易平台及四大ETF投資主題，並設計「ETF神配對」等互動遊戲與電子集章闖關。兆豐銀行機器人理財結合晨星（Morningstar）專業機制，基金最低新台幣2000元、ETF最低3000元即可投資；兆豐證券美股GO享手續費均一價且無低收門檻。民眾集滿4個電子章可兌換限定好禮，體驗機器人理財還可享用冰沙。
第一銀行首度以「高資產業務」為核心參展，打造「第一領航・豐盈之境」主題展區。視覺呼應高雄亞灣港灣意象，展示財管2.0高資產業務開辦5年成果、高雄專區業務及家族辦公室服務。第一銀行身為首批進駐高雄專區的銀行之一，專區客戶數已突破500戶，資產管理規模衝上700億元大關。現場亦詳細介紹高資產客戶專屬尊榮權益與優惠。
臺灣企銀以「匠心淬鍊，世代傳承」為核心，將工藝美學結合金融服務打造財富管理體驗館。展區規劃半導體、精密機械、鋼鐵及航運四大主題區。半導體區展示福企無限卡權益；精密機械區透過滑軌裝置傳遞長期投資累積理念；鋼鐵區以金屬淬鍊意象強調風險預防；航運區則展示家族辦公室服務與企業接班議題。台灣企銀今年9月已正式進駐高雄資產管理專區，展區現場提供精美限量好禮。
彰化銀行呼應亞洲資產管理中心落地高雄，以「彰銀泊樂港」主題館參展，聚焦TISA全民資產累積與高資產家族傳承。「TISA泊樂互動區」以「從1000元開始，TISA基金・築夢未來」為主題，推出碼頭闖關遊戲與講座，引導民眾透過網路銀行辦理TISA基金定期定額。「亞灣海境貴賓室」則舉辦家族辦公室資產規劃講座並提供一對一諮詢。參加高資產或TISA講座均可獲得專屬禮品。

items.title: 應輝達要求研擬生產3D DRAM？台積電最新回應！
items.title_en: TSMC Responds to Nvidia's Request to Explore 3D DRAM Production
paras: 市場傳出台積電 (TSM-US) 應輝達 (Nvidia)(NVDA-US) 要求，研擬先進記憶體 3D DRAM 製造計畫，並評估自建新廠或收購既有廠房改建。不過，台積電重申將持續專注專業晶圓代工、服務全球邏輯晶片產業，未證實相關投資。
《Tom’s Hardware》分析，3D DRAM 即使對既有記憶體大廠而言，距離成熟商用仍有多年。台積電若投入，不僅需要建立不同於邏輯晶片的製程能力，還須承擔龐大資本支出與記憶體景氣循環風險，難以藉此解決眼前的供應短缺。
《The Information》6 日引述兩名知情人士報導，台積電應輝達要求，開始規劃 3D DRAM 製造，可能採取興建新廠，或收購現有半導體工廠後改建等方式，但尚未揭露量產時間表。
報導稱，相關計畫由台積電副總經理徐國晉主導。徐國晉負責研究發展及先進封裝技術發展，職掌涵蓋 3D IC 與先進封裝系統整合技術，過去曾擔任台灣美光董事長，具有記憶體產業經驗。
針對傳聞，台積電發言人向《Tom’s Hardware》表示，不評論市場傳聞或臆測，強調公司的核心業務始終是專業晶圓代工，目標是持續成為「全球邏輯晶片」產業，值得信賴的技術與產能供應商。輝達則未立即回應外媒置評請求。
台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 大漲 6.33% 至每股 375.56 美元，折溢價達 15.27%，換算價為 2461.04 元。
華邦電董事長焦佑鈞 7 日表示，跨足 DRAM 必須克服自主技術與專利門檻，考量台積電與記憶體業者已有緊密合作，他評估台積電自行投入 DRAM 產品開發的可能性不高。他認為，台積電若決定投入，會在技術準備成熟後才對外說明，但強調相關看法屬個人推測，並未向業者求證。
3D DRAM 與 HBM 不同　難解短期缺貨
技術上，本文所指的 3D DRAM 與目前 AI 市場大量採用的高頻寬記憶體 (HBM)，雖然都涉及垂直堆疊，堆疊的層級卻不同。HBM 主要將多顆 DRAM 晶粒堆疊並互連；3D DRAM 則是在記憶體製造架構中，將記憶單元向垂直方向配置，以提高單位面積的容量。
這項差異意味著，台積電既有的先進封裝能力，不能直接等同於具備 3D DRAM 製造技術。
DRAM 與邏輯晶片需要不同的製程能力，而 3D DRAM 還須解決多層記憶單元的製造、缺陷控制與良率問題。美光、三星及 SK 海力士均在開發相關技術，但距離成熟商用仍有一段路；以美光為例，其技術規劃仍包括持續推進多代平面 DRAM 製程。
該媒體判斷，台積電即使投入相關開發，也難以在至少五年內藉此緩解目前的記憶體短缺，顯示這類布局更偏向長期技術與產能規劃。
收購仍須長期投資　跨足製造牽動合作關係
《Tom’s Hardware》分析，收購具有自有晶圓廠的特殊型記憶體業者，可能讓台積電取得部分技術、人才與智慧財產，降低從零起步的難度。但小型業者通常不具備最先進的大宗 DRAM 製程，後續仍可能需要數十億美元及多年研發投入，才能建立具競爭力的技術。
投資風險也不僅限於技術。記憶體缺貨與價格上漲往往刺激擴產，但當新增產能集中開出，又可能造成供過於求，壓低價格與獲利，使投資回收面臨不確定性。
此外，台積電若自行製造 DRAM，也可能改變與既有合作夥伴的關係。
SK 海力士於 2024 年宣布與台積電合作，規劃將台積電先進邏輯製程用於 HBM4 的邏輯基底晶片；若台積電進一步跨入記憶單元製造，雙方可能同時存在合作與競爭關係。
HBM 基底晶片、先進封裝　仍可分享記憶體商機
台積電仍可透過生產 HBM 邏輯基底晶片、運用 SoIC 混合鍵合技術整合記憶體與處理器，以及攜手創意與既有 DRAM 業者開發客製化方案，提高在先進記憶體供應鏈中的附加價值。
這些途徑可延伸台積電既有的邏輯製程與先進封裝優勢，同時降低自行建立完整 DRAM 製程及新建晶圓廠的資金負擔，讓公司持續分享 AI 記憶體需求成長帶來的商機。
paras_en: Market rumors suggest that TSMC (TSM-US) is being asked by Nvidia (NVDA-US) to develop an advanced 3D DRAM memory manufacturing plan and to evaluate building a new fab or acquiring an existing plant for conversion. However, TSMC reiterated that it will continue to focus on professional wafer foundry services for the global logic chip industry and has not confirmed any such investment.

Tom’s Hardware analysis notes that even for established memory manufacturers, 3D DRAM is still several years away from mature commercial deployment. If TSMC were to enter the space, it would need to build process capabilities distinct from logic chips, shoulder massive capital expenditures, and bear the cyclical risks of the memory market, making it unlikely to solve the current supply shortage quickly.

The Information reported on the 6th, citing two insiders, that TSMC, at Nvidia’s request, has begun planning 3D DRAM production and may consider either building a new fab or acquiring and retrofitting an existing semiconductor plant, though no mass‑production timeline has been disclosed.

The report says the effort is led by TSMC Vice President Xu Guojin, who oversees R&D and advanced packaging technology, covering 3D IC and advanced packaging system integration. Xu previously served as chairman of Micron Technology Taiwan and brings memory‑industry experience.

When asked about the rumors, a TSMC spokesperson told Tom’s Hardware that the company does not comment on market speculation and emphasized that its core business remains professional wafer foundry, aiming to remain a trusted technology and capacity supplier for the global logic chip industry. Nvidia did not immediately respond to media inquiries.
TSMC ADR (TSM-US) surged 6.33% to $375.56 per share, a premium of 15.27%, equivalent to a price of NT$2,461.04.

WPG Holdings chairman Jiao Youjun said on the 7th that entering DRAM would require overcoming proprietary technology and patent barriers. Given TSMC’s close ties with memory makers, he judges the likelihood of TSMC independently developing DRAM products as low. He believes that if TSMC decides to invest, it would announce it only after the technology is mature, but stresses that his view is personal speculation and not verified with the company.
3D DRAM differs from HBM and does not solve short‑term shortages

Technically, the 3D DRAM discussed in this article differs from the high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) widely used in AI today. While both involve vertical stacking, the stacking hierarchy is different: HBM stacks multiple DRAM dies and interconnects them, whereas 3D DRAM arranges memory cells vertically within the memory architecture to increase capacity per unit area.
This distinction means TSMC’s existing advanced‑packaging capabilities cannot be directly equated with 3D DRAM manufacturing technology.

DRAM and logic chips require different process capabilities, and 3D DRAM also must address multi‑layer cell fabrication, defect control, and yield challenges. Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix are all developing related technologies, but commercial maturity is still some way off; for example, Micron’s roadmap still includes continued advancement of planar DRAM generations.

The media judges that even if TSMC invests in development, it is unlikely to alleviate the current memory shortage within at least five years, indicating that such a move is more of a long‑term technology and capacity planning effort.
Acquisitions still require long‑term investment and affect partnership dynamics

Tom’s Hardware analysis suggests that acquiring a specialty memory company with its own fab could give TSMC access to some technology, talent and IP, reducing the difficulty of starting from scratch. However, smaller players usually lack the most advanced high‑volume DRAM processes, and significant billions of dollars and years of R&D would still be needed to build competitive capability.

Investment risk is not limited to technology. Memory shortages and price spikes often spur capacity expansion, but when new capacity comes online simultaneously, oversupply can depress prices and margins, making payback uncertain.
Moreover, if TSMC were to manufacture DRAM itself, it could alter its relationships with existing partners.

SK Hynix announced in 2024 a collaboration with TSMC to use TSMC’s advanced logic process for the logic base chip of HBM4; if TSMC later moves into memory‑cell production, the two companies could find themselves both cooperating and competing.
HBM base chips and advanced packaging can still share memory‑market opportunities

TSMC can continue to produce HBM logic base chips, employ SoIC hybrid bonding to integrate memory and processors, and work with creative and existing DRAM firms on custom solutions, enhancing its value in the advanced memory supply chain.

These pathways extend TSMC’s existing logic‑process and advanced‑packaging strengths while reducing the financial burden of building a full DRAM process and new fab, allowing the company to keep sharing the business opportunities driven by growing AI memory demand.

items.title: 台積電傳進軍3D DRAM市場！輝達要求布局、AI記憶體短缺推升擴產需求
items.title_en: TSMC Said to Eye Entry into 3D DRAM Market; Nvidia Pushes for Deployment, AI Memory Shortage Drives Expansion Demand
paras: 全球人工智慧（AI）熱潮持續推升記憶體需求，晶片供應短缺問題日益嚴重。外媒披露，台積電(2330-TW、TSM-US) 正評估跨足先進記憶體晶片市場，考慮投入生產3D動態隨機存取記憶體（3D DRAM），據傳是應輝達(NVDA-US) 要求而起。若計畫成真，台積電將從現有的邏輯晶片代工業務，進一步延伸至記憶體領域，在AI硬體供應鏈扮演更關鍵的角色。
根據《The Information》周五（6日）報導，台積電正評估生產先進記憶體晶片的可行性，並將3D DRAM列為主要技術方向。這項技術被視為記憶體產業的尖端發展方向，與台積電既有的先進製程技術也具有一定協同空間。
台積電目前是輝達AI處理器的主要代工廠，若進一步承接記憶體晶片生產，將使其業務範圍從邏輯晶片延伸至記憶體，有助輝達等AI客戶更全面掌握未來晶片供應情況，也可能在中長期緩解市場供應壓力。
不過，台積電目前尚未承諾投入相關生產。《The Information》也未披露具體時程、投資規模或預計產能。
這波晶片短缺已對全球主要設備製造商的利潤率造成明顯壓力，也推高蘋果(AAPL-US) iPhone、索尼(SONY-US) PlayStation等消費電子產品的終端售價。
供應緊張的原因之一，是AI基礎設施建設熱潮帶動高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求大幅增加。
中國大陸記憶體大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 同樣計畫擴大產能。若台積電進一步進軍記憶體市場，將為全球記憶體產業帶來新的競爭變數。
除了供應鏈壓力，AI產業後續投資動能也面臨不確定性。美國民主黨本周在國會兩院選舉中取得全面勝利後，AI企業與投資人開始關注，未來是否可能出現限制資料中心建設的政策措施，進而拖慢AI基礎設施投資，甚至引發市場對AI泡沫的疑慮。
另一方面，台積電股價本周也隨台灣加權股價指數（TAIEX）大幅走跌。加權指數周五盤中一度重挫近9%，進入熊市區間，創下2001年以來最差單周表現。
paras_en: The global AI boom continues to lift memory demand, and chip supply shortages are becoming increasingly severe. Foreign media disclosed that TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) is evaluating a move into the advanced memory chip market, considering production of 3D dynamic random‑access memory (3D DRAM), reportedly at the request of Nvidia (NVDA‑US). If the plan materializes, TSMC would extend its existing logic chip foundry business into the memory sector, playing a more critical role in the AI hardware supply chain.

According to a report by The Information on Friday (the 6th), TSMC is assessing the feasibility of producing advanced memory chips and has listed 3D DRAM as a primary technology focus. This technology is seen as a cutting‑edge development direction for the memory industry and offers some synergy with TSMC’s existing advanced process technologies.

TSMC is currently the main foundry for Nvidia’s AI processors; taking on memory chip production would broaden its business from logic chips to memory, helping Nvidia and other AI customers gain a more comprehensive grasp of future chip supply and potentially easing market supply pressure in the medium to long term.
However, TSMC has not yet committed to related production. The Information also did not disclose a specific timeline, investment scale, or expected capacity.

This wave of chip shortages has already put noticeable pressure on profit margins of major equipment manufacturers worldwide and has pushed up the end‑user prices of consumer electronics such as Apple (AAPL‑US) iPhones and Sony (SONY‑US) PlayStation consoles.
One reason for the tight supply is the surge in demand for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) driven by the AI infrastructure construction boom.

China’s major memory maker ChangXin Technology (688825‑CN) is also planning to expand capacity. If TSMC moves further into the memory market, it would introduce a new competitive variable to the global memory industry.

Beyond supply‑chain pressure, the AI industry’s subsequent investment momentum also faces uncertainty. After the U.S. Democratic Party’s sweeping victories in both houses of Congress this week, AI firms and investors are watching whether policies could emerge that restrict data‑center construction, potentially slowing AI infrastructure investment and even sparking doubts about an AI bubble.

Meanwhile, TSMC’s stock price this week fell sharply along with the Taiwan Weighted Index (TAIEX). The index plunged nearly 9% intraday on Friday, entering bear‑market territory and recording its worst weekly performance since 2001.

items.title: SpaceX董事會重大異動！Google高層哈里森任職逾10年請辭、馬斯克曝Alphabet利益衝突
items.title_en: SpaceX Board Major Changes! Google Executive Harrison Resigns After Over 10 Years, Musk Reveals Alphabet Conflict of Interest
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US) 董事會出現重大人事異動，Google(GOOGL-US) 全球合作與企業發展總裁哈里森（Donald Harrison）在任職逾10年後辭去董事職務，並於11月4日生效。SpaceX執行長馬斯克隨後在社群平台X表示，哈里森是因涉及Google母公司Alphabet的利益衝突過多，才決定退出董事會。
根據《Investing.com》報導，SpaceX週五（6日）公布的監管文件披露，哈里森已於11月4日通知公司辭職，且即刻生效。文件指出，這項人事異動並非源於他與公司在營運、政策或實務方面存在任何分歧。
馬斯克隨後在X發文解釋，哈里森面臨太多與Alphabet相關的利益衝突，但也肯定他在SpaceX董事會任職期間的貢獻，並對其服務表達感謝。
哈里森目前擔任Google全球合作與企業發展總裁，是公司高階主管之一，負責管理合作夥伴關係及推動策略性商業計畫。
Alphabet是SpaceX的重要投資者。根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，Alphabet是SpaceX最大的單一機構股東。
Google週五另行披露，持有的SpaceX股份已增至約5.55億股，高於先前的約5.512 億股，顯示哈里森請辭之際，Alphabet對SpaceX的持股仍在增加。
不過，目前公布的資料並未顯示，這項董事會人事異動會影響兩家公司之間的投資關係。
SpaceX業務版圖正不斷擴大，涵蓋火箭發射、衛星通訊及人工智慧（AI）等領域。馬斯克表示，Alphabet持有SpaceX大量股份，加上哈里森在Google擔任高階主管，導致兩家公司之間出現利益重疊。
SpaceX並未具體說明，執行長所指的利益衝突涉及哪些交易、商業合作安排或董事會決策。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) announced a major board personnel change: Donald Harrison, Google’s (GOOGL‑US) President of Global Partnerships and Corporate Development, resigned from the board after more than ten years of service, effective November 4. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk later posted on X that Harrison stepped down because of excessive conflicts of interest involving Alphabet, Google’s parent company.

According to a report from Investing.com, regulatory filings released by SpaceX on Friday (the 6th) show that Harrison notified the company of his resignation on November 4, with immediate effect. The documents state that the change was not due to any operational, policy, or practical disagreements with the company.

Musk subsequently explained on X that Harrison faced too many Alphabet‑related conflicts of interest, but also praised his contributions while serving on SpaceX’s board and thanked him for his service.

Harrison currently serves as Google’s President of Global Partnerships and Corporate Development, one of the firm’s senior executives responsible for managing partner relationships and driving strategic business initiatives.
Alphabet is a major investor in SpaceX. LSEG data indicate that Alphabet is SpaceX’s largest single institutional shareholder.

Google disclosed on Friday that its stake in SpaceX had risen to roughly 555 million shares, up from about 551.2 million shares previously, showing that Alphabet’s holding continued to increase even as Harrison stepped down.
However, the information released so far does not indicate that this board change will affect the investment relationship between the two companies.

SpaceX’s business scope is continually expanding, covering rocket launches, satellite communications and artificial intelligence (AI). Musk said that Alphabet’s large stake in SpaceX, combined with Harrison’s senior role at Google, creates overlapping interests between the two firms.
SpaceX did not specify which transactions, commercial collaborations or board decisions Musk was referring to when he mentioned the conflict of interest.

items.title: Helios旗下Faster首度取得資料中心熱管理訂單液壓快速接頭跨足AI液冷市場
items.title_en: Helios' Faster Secures First Data Center Thermal Management Order, Expands into AI Liquid Cooling Market
paras: 2026年11月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國工業設備製造商Helios Technologies(HLIO-US)於11月5日公布第三季財報，並宣布旗下義大利子公司Faster在季度結束後取得首筆熱管理產品訂單，正式切入資料中心散熱供應鏈。Faster原本以液壓快速接頭為核心業務，近年將相關技術延伸至液冷系統所需的流體連接元件，隨著AI伺服器功耗提高，公司開始尋求傳統工程機械與農業設備以外的新市場。
Faster先前已推出針對次世代熱管理系統設計的液冷快速接頭，主要用於冷卻液管路之間的連接與拆卸。相較於完整的液冷系統，Faster聚焦的是其中的關鍵零組件，產品必須具備良好的密封性與可靠度，避免冷卻液洩漏影響伺服器運作。這類產品可應用於資料中心液冷設備及相關流體迴路，與公司既有液壓接頭技術具有相通之處。
Helios執行長表示，Faster取得首筆熱管理訂單，達成公司原先設定於年底前進入資料中心市場的目標。
從產業發展來看，隨著AI加速器功耗持續提高，資料中心開始增加直接液冷至晶片等散熱架構的採用，除了冷卻液分配單元（CDU）及冷板之外，連接管路所需的快速接頭也成為相關設備的採購項目。Faster的市場定位並非與大型液冷系統供應商競爭，而是爭取成為CDU製造商、機櫃廠及系統整合商的零組件供應商。
大型電力與散熱設備業者也持續擴充產品組合。伊頓Eaton(ETN-US)今年3月完成以95億美元收購Boyd Thermal，施耐德電機Schneider Electric則於2025年取得Motivair的75%股權，擴大資料中心液冷設備布局。隨著大型供應商整合冷卻系統與相關設備，快速接頭等流體連接元件的採購需求也可能增加，但Faster能否取得後續訂單，仍取決於產品認證、客戶導入及供貨能力。
Helios第三季營收達2.3億美元，年增4%，創歷年第三季新高；按備考基礎計算，營收成長13%，其中液壓業務成長15%，電子業務成長9%。Faster隸屬液壓部門，目前資料中心仍屬新開發市場，首筆訂單尚不足以改變整體營收結構。
公司同時上調2026年全年營收展望，但財務長預期第四季成長速度將較第三季放慢，並指出通膨成本仍對獲利率形成壓力，近期產品漲價效益預計要到2027年才會更完整反映。因此，Faster切入AI資料中心供應鏈後，後續能否取得重複訂單、擴大客戶數量，以及開始形成具規模的營收貢獻，將是觀察這項新業務發展的重點。

paras_en: On November 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – U.S. industrial equipment maker Helios Technologies (HLIO-US) announced its third‑quarter results on November 5 and said its Italian subsidiary Faster landed its first thermal‑management product order after the quarter ended, officially entering the data‑center cooling supply chain. Faster, originally focused on hydraulic quick‑connect couplings, has in recent years extended the technology to fluid‑connection components needed for liquid‑cooling systems, and as AI server power consumption rises, the company is seeking new markets beyond traditional industrial machinery and agricultural equipment.

Faster previously introduced a liquid‑cooling quick‑connect fitting designed for next‑generation thermal‑management systems, primarily used to connect and disconnect coolant pipelines. Compared with a complete liquid‑cooling system, Faster concentrates on this critical component, which must provide excellent sealing and reliability to prevent coolant leaks that could affect server operation. These fittings can be used in data‑center liquid‑cooling equipment and related fluid loops, sharing common technology with the company’s existing hydraulic couplings.
Helios’s chief executive said Faster’s acquisition of its first thermal‑management order fulfills the company’s goal of entering the data‑center market by year‑end.

From an industry perspective, as AI accelerator power draw continues to rise, data centers are increasingly adopting direct liquid cooling to chips and other thermal architectures. In addition to coolant distribution units (CDUs) and cold plates, quick‑connect fittings for the piping become procurement items. Faster’s market positioning is not to compete with large liquid‑cooling system suppliers but to become a component supplier for CDU manufacturers, rack makers, and system integrators.

Major power and cooling equipment firms are also expanding their product portfolios. Eaton (ETN-US) completed a $9.5 billion acquisition of Boyd Thermal in March, and Schneider Electric acquired a 75% stake in Motivair in 2025, broadening its data‑center liquid‑cooling equipment footprint. As large suppliers integrate cooling systems and related hardware, demand for fluid‑connection components such as quick‑connect fittings may rise, but Faster’s ability to secure follow‑on orders will depend on product certification, customer adoption, and supply capability.

Helios reported third‑quarter revenue of $230 million, up 4% year‑over‑year, a record high for any third quarter; on a constant‑currency basis revenue grew 13%, with hydraulic business up 15% and electronics up 9%. Faster belongs to the hydraulic division, and the data‑center segment remains a newly developed market, so the first order is insufficient to alter the overall revenue mix.

The company also raised its full‑year 2026 revenue outlook, but the CFO expects fourth‑quarter growth to slow relative to the third quarter and notes that inflationary costs continue to pressure margins, with recent product price‑increase benefits not expected to be fully reflected until 2027. Consequently, after Faster’s entry into the AI data‑center supply chain, the key points to watch are whether it can secure repeat orders, expand its customer base, and begin to generate a sizable revenue contribution.
